title: Between Arrivals
prose: Ulenna shows an empty nest without touching it. A second bird has begun carrying stems to the next hollow.

choices.label: Keep watching
choices.line: An empty room can still belong to the next arrival.

choices.label: Return by the marked path
choices.line: I left the hollow as I found it, with another use on the way.
